title: Track an order
question: Where is my order? How do I track my package?
answer: Log in and open My Orders, then choose Track. A tracking link is emailed within 24 hours after your order is dispatched.

title: Cancel an order
question: How can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel free of charge from My Orders until the order is dispatched. After dispatch it cannot be cancelled, but you can return it once delivered.

title: Change an order
question: Can I change the items or size in my order?
answer: Items and sizes can be edited from My Orders before dispatch. After dispatch an order cannot be changed.

title: Delivery times
question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days, express 1-2 business days, and international 7-14 business days.

title: Change shipping address
question: How do I change my delivery address?
answer: The address can be changed from My Orders before dispatch. After dispatch the address cannot be changed.

title: Refund policy
question: What is your refund policy? Can I return an item for my money back?
answer: Unused items in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds go to the original payment method. Refund requests are reviewed by our team.

title: Refund status
question: Where is my refund? How long do refunds take?
answer: Refunds are issued 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item. You will get a confirmation email. If 10 business days have passed, contact support with your order number.

title: Payment methods
question: Which payment methods do you accept? Can I pay with Bitcoin, crypto, cash or bank transfer?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard and PayPal. Cash on delivery and cryptocurrency are not available.

title: Charged twice / payment problem
question: I was charged twice or my payment failed.
answer: A failed payment can leave a temporary hold that disappears within 3-5 business days. If you still see two charges after that, contact support with your order number.

title: Invoices
question: How do I get an invoice or receipt?
answer: Invoices are emailed when the order is dispatched. You can also download a PDF from My Orders under Invoice.

title: Reset password
question: I forgot my password or cannot log in.
answer: Click Forgot password on the login page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

title: Delete account
question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Settings, then Account, then Delete account. Deletion is permanent after a 14-day grace period in which you can cancel it.

title: Newsletter
question: How do I unsubscribe from the newsletter?
answer: Use the Unsubscribe link at the bottom of any newsletter email. Changes apply within 48 hours.

title: Contact support
question: How can I talk to a person? What are your support hours?
answer: Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00-17:00 via live chat or support@example.com.
